message: The other evening, we had a surprise blackout just as I was settling in with a cozy book and a cup of tea. I remembered the power bank I had charged up last month, so I grabbed it and my phone, which meant I could still read my e-book without missing a beat. It felt like a small victory to keep the evening enjoyable instead of scrambling around in the dark. Have you ever had a moment where a little preparation made all the difference?
